description: MOVEit Crypto is a compact and fast dynamically-linked library for Windows and Linux. It provides AES encryption, SHA-1 and SHA-2 hashing, and pseudo-random number generation. Both 32-bit and 64-bit versions are available for each operating system. MOVEit Crypto is a member of the MOVEit security and file transfer product family.
